About.title: A modern station with an old idea of work.
About.p1: Station Eight Labs started from a simple conviction: ambitious companies deserve a technical partner that can sit still with a hard problem.
About.p2: The name looks back at Hut 8 — the Bletchley Park section that worked German naval Enigma, for a time under Alan Turing. Intercepts in, decisions out. Paper, probability, machines. We take the discipline, not the uniform.
About.p3: The contemporary reading is plainer. Station: a powerful workspace. Eight: the bits that become a byte. We design, build, and hold systems for clients worldwide, with English and French as first-class languages.
About.v1: We will not decorate a confusion. Discovery is part of the fee because it is part of the work.
About.v2: Ship complete units. A half-integrated suite is not a gift.
About.v3: Repos, clouds, stores — in your name. We are easy to fire, on purpose.
About.v4: Europe is not an afterthought. The site, the contracts later, the product copy — EN and FR.
